title: AS2 compiler: random(n) should emit ActionRandomNumber (0x30) not ActionCallFunction
description: In AVM1, the global random(n) function emits ActionRandomNumber (0x30) — it pops n from stack and pushes a random integer in [0, n). The AS2 compiler currently falls through to ActionCallFunction (0x3D). Fix: in compiler.ts compileCallExpr, detect Identifier('random') with exactly 1 arg, compile the arg, then emit opcode 0x30. Note: Math.random() does NOT have a special opcode and should remain as ActionCallFunction for the Math object's random method.
